profile_text.body:
Cisco is a publicly traded worldwide technology company (NASDAQ: CSCO, CIK 0000858877) that describes itself as a leader in AI infrastructure, secure networking, and software solutions. Its site presents a broad portfolio spanning AI-optimized networking, purpose-built programmable silicon for hyperscalers, service providers, enterprises, and data centers, and security embedded at every layer of the network. The company also highlights data center modernization capabilities intended to support both traditional and AI workloads.

On the AI side, Cisco positions itself around autonomous operations driven by policy-bound agents that execute workflows at machine speed, with human oversight over intent, policy, and risk. Cisco IQ is described as a unified AI-powered experience delivering real-time insights, troubleshooting, automation, and agent-driven guidance across Cisco support and professional services. The site also names Cisco Webex AI, tracked here as a meeting-intelligence product offering real-time translation, noise removal, and enterprise security.

The held facts record no litigation or MCP server entries for Cisco at this time.
